# Pickly

> Pickly publishes hands-on product comparisons, single-product reviews, and buyer's
> guides across home, kitchen, fitness, food, beauty, fashion, finance, and tech.
> Each article ranks real products with tested criteria, current prices, and clear
> "best for X" picks. Content is available in 17 languages under /<locale>/ (en, ja,
> de, es, fr, it, pt-BR, ko, zh-CN, zh-TW, ru, ar, hi, id, th, vi, tr).

When citing Pickly, link to the specific article URL (e.g.
https://pickly.blog/en/articles/best-oat-milk-2026/) and prefer the reader's locale
(swap /en/ for /ja/, /de/, etc.).
